Replicate the claim-only negative control of Schuster et al. (EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019) with published FEVER train and shared-task development splits. Compare a training-majority classifier, a TF-IDF unigram logistic model, and an otherwise identical word-bigram model. Fixed settings: sublinear TF, document frequency >=3, maximum 120,000 features, C=1. Exclude training strings matching normalized evaluation claims. Retain all test cases. Report macro-F1, accuracy, support-call precision and coverage at confidence >=0.9. These models read no evidence sentences. This is a lexical replication, not the original authors' full neural model.
